sampling.allocation: Hamilton largest remainder using exact integer remainders
sampling.within_stratum: ascending SHA256(UTF8(compact JSON [seed, query_id])), then query_id
sampling.output_order: original conversation index, then original unfiltered QA index
sampling.hash_contract: SHA256 of UTF-8 newline-joined IDs, no trailing newline

pairing.policy: No resampling by arm or architecture; failures retain original IDs and denominator 400; do not replace missing questions.

exposure.note: Conversations 0/1 are available for development; prior experiment execution or inspection prevents claiming an untouched blind test. Report this as a fixed paired pilot.
